target_meaning: Probability that a resolved SBA 7(a) loan is charged off.
risk_score: Integer 0-1000. Higher is safer: round((1 - pd_chargeoff) * 1000).
data: U.S. SBA 7(a) FOIA, approvals FY2010-FY2019, file as of 2026-06-30.
trained_on: Resolved loans (PIF or CHGOFF) approved in FY2010-FY2015.
excluded_from_fit: Terms that are not a multiple of 12 months. They contain about 90% of charge-offs and do not match standard loan products.
FY2018-FY2019, because SBA replaced the business-age categories in calendar 2018
InitialInterestRate, because the lender set it from its own risk view

inputs.loan_amount: Approved amount in US dollars. Rubles are a different scale.
inputs.naics_code: NAICS code or its first two digits.
inputs.business_type: CORPORATION, INDIVIDUAL, or PARTNERSHIP. ООО maps to CORPORATION, ИП to INDIVIDUAL.
inputs.business_age: existing_5y_plus, age_2_to_5, under_2y, startup, or unknown.
inputs.revolver: yes for a revolving line, no for a term loan.
